versions.notes:
*FRESHMILK FM is now OutBeat - same app, new name and logo
*A quick tour on the front page shows you around when you open the app. The "How it works" link brings it back any time
*Pick your own app icon under Theme. Eight to choose from, and it changes the tray, the taskbar and your shortcuts
*Presets: the editing panel now sits under the list, and every preset shows a picture of its own design
*Right after this update a message asks you to finish the move to the new name. Press the button and it does the rest - OutBeat closes while the installer runs, then starts again with everything renamed. Your design, presets, fonts, theme and sign-ins are all kept, and there is nothing to delete or move first

*Turned items can be moved again instead of sticking
*Resizing a turned item follows your cursor properly
*No more empty space around the cassette artwork

*Bug fixes,
*Feedback menu - so you can say whatever you want to us, we're used to it at this point XD
The Update button, and the sketch backgrounds.
